checked_how: Each number below was read in the text of the cited page by script, one request at a time. Numbers that appeared only in secondary reports or in chart images were left out.

polls.summary: Which of Schumer or Van Hollen people would rather have lead Senate Democrats.
notes: * The YouGov write-up gives 14%, 28% and 59% for all citizens and 19% and 40% for Democrats. The 41% for Democrats is the remainder, not a number printed on the page.
Percentages are rounded and may not add to 100.

polls.population: Likely voters who are Democrats or lean Democratic
polls.summary: Whether Democratic-leaning voters want a new Senate leader, and which candidate they prefer.

rows.label: Senate Democrats should choose a new leader
Democratic leadership should choose new leaders

head_to_head.question: Choose between Van Hollen and Schumer to lead Senate Democrats, based on what they know about the candidates.

notes: The page gives the head-to-head as margins (a plurality, plus 8 points overall). The exact shares are not printed in the page text, so they are not shown.
Subgroup results have larger margins of error, per the pollster.

left_out: An Indivisible/YouGov poll (Nov 7-9) appears in Wikipedia's table but its page was not found, so it is not shown. Member votes held by advocacy groups (MoveOn, Indivisible) are self-selected, not polls, and are not shown.
